historical_references.reference: Rasid was a general under the Hindu king Udayana of Anahatakapada (Gujarat) who ruled in the late 10th or early 11th century. Rasid is known for his defeat of the Chalukyan king Jayasimha II in the Battle of Bakel in 1022 AD, which established Udayana's dominance over southern India.
historical_references.context: Military victory over the Chalukyan king Jayasimha II

historical_references.reference: Rasid is also mentioned in the Epics of the Chalukyan king Vikramaditya VI, who ruled between 1110 and 1142 AD. In this context, Rasid is portrayed as a powerful and loyal general who served under Vikramaditya and was instrumental in his victories.
